blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Skills are widely assumed to play a central role in career transitions, motivating their use in career path prediction (CPP) systems. In this work, we critically examine whether explicit skill representations provide complementary signal beyond text-based job representations. We evaluate multiple strategies for incorporating skills into CPP models, including score fusion and neural architectures, under two conditions: predicted skills and ground-truth ESCO annotations. Surprisingly, across two benchmark datasets, none of these settings yield substantial improvements over strong text-only baselines. Even when using ground-truth skills, gains remain marginal and inconsistent. Through detailed analysis, we identify key factors underlying this result: high redundancy between textual and skill representations, limited discriminative power of ESCO's taxonomy, and representational collapse in skill embeddings. Furthermore, we find that skill prediction difficulty correlates with overall sample difficulty, limiting the potential for complementary signals. Our findings challenge the common assumption that explicit skill modeling inherently benefits career prediction and suggest that dense text representations already capture most skill-relevant information.
blocks.zh: 技能被广泛认为在职业过渡中发挥中心作用,促使其在职业路径预测系统中的使用。 在这项工作中,我们严格审查明确的技能表述是否提供了超越基于文本的工作表述的补充信号。 我们评价将技能纳入CPP模型的多种战略,包括分数聚变和神经结构,在两个条件下:预测技能和地面真实ESCO说明。 令人惊讶的是,在两个基准数据集中,没有任何一个设置比仅以文本为主的有力基线有重大改进。 即使在使用地面真实技能时,收益仍然微不足道和不一致。 通过详细分析,我们找出这一结果背后的关键因素:文字和技能表述之间的高度冗余,ESCO分类法的歧视性力量有限,以及技能嵌入中的代表性崩溃。 此外,我们发现技能预测困难与总体抽样困难有关,限制了补充信号的潜力。 我们的调查结果对共同的假设提出质疑,即明确的技能模型在本质上有利于职业预测,并表明密集的文字表述已经掌握了大多数与技能有关的信息。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Career Path Prediction (CPP), the task of forecasting an individual’s next occupation based on their professional history, has gained increasing attention in both academia and industry Senger et al. (2025) , Gasco et al. (2025) . Accurate CPP models enable a wide range of applications, including personalized career guidance, workforce planning, and talent management, to name a few examples. With the growing availability of large-scale career data and advances in natural language processing (NLP), recent approaches model career trajectories as sequences of textual descriptions such as job titles and responsibilities, learning predictive patterns directly from unstructured text.
blocks.zh: 职业路径预测(CPP)是根据个人的职业历史预测个人下一个职业的任务,在学术界和业界Senger等人(2025年),Gasco等人(2025年)都得到了越来越多的关注. 准确的CPP模式使得各种应用,包括个性化的职业指导,员工队伍规划和人才管理,能够举几个例子. 随着大规模职业数据的不断普及和自然语言处理(NLP)的进步,最近的方法将职业轨迹作为诸如职称和责任等文字描述的序列,直接从无结构文字中学习预测规律.

blocks.en:
Despite strong empirical performance, these text-based approaches rely on an implicit assumption: that textual representations sufficiently capture the underlying drivers of career transitions. However, from a labor market perspective, skills—the transferable competencies acquired through experience—are widely regarded as the primary mechanism governing occupational mobility. This has led to a natural hypothesis: explicitly modeling skills should provide additional, structured signal that improves career path prediction beyond text-only baselines.
Recent developments make this hypothesis practically testable. Large-scale taxonomies such as ESCO 1 1 1 European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations: https://esco.ec.europa.eu/en/about-esco/what-esco provide standardized mappings between occupations and skills, while modern retrieval and language models enable the extraction of structured skill representations from unstructured career histories. Together, these advances suggest a promising direction: augmenting CPP models with explicit skill information inferred from text.
However, obtaining reliable skill representations from unstructured career histories is non-trivial, as the same role can be expressed in highly varied ways across individuals and contexts. We address this through a retrieval-based pipeline that grounds job titles and descriptions in ESCO occupations, from which associated skills are derived. Hierarchical occupational structure is further leveraged to improve skill coverage and consistency.
blocks.zh:
尽管经验性很强,但这些基于文字的方法依赖于一种隐含的假设:即文字表述足以捕捉职业过渡的基本动力. 然而,从劳动力市场的角度来看,技能——通过经验获得的可转移能力——被广泛视为管理职业流动的主要机制。 这导致了一种自然假说:明确的建模技能应提供额外的,结构化的信号,以改善超越文本唯一基线的职业路径预测.
最近的事态发展使得这一假设实际上可以验证。 大规模分类学,如ESCO 1 1 1 欧洲技能,能力,资格和职业:https://esco.ec.europa.eu/en/about-esco/What-esco提供职业与技能之间的标准化绘图,而现代检索和语言模型则能够从无结构的职业历史中提取结构化的技能表现. 这些进展共同表明一个有希望的方向:通过从案文中推断出的明确技能信息来增强CPP模式。
然而,从无结构的职业史中获取可靠的技能说明是非部落性的,因为同样的作用可以在个人和背景中以不同的方式表达。 我们通过一个以检索为基础的管道来解决这一问题,该管道为ESCO职业中的职称和说明提供依据,而相关技能正是从这些职业中产生的。 进一步利用等级职业结构来提高技能覆盖面和一致性。

blocks.en:
In this work, we take a step back and critically examine this assumption. Rather than focusing on improving skill extraction, we ask a more fundamental question: do explicit skill representations actually improve career path prediction, and if not, why do they fail to provide complementary signal? To answer this, we conduct a systematic study across multiple skill sources and integration strategies. Specifically, we evaluate two settings: (1) predicted skills inferred from occupations and (2) ground-truth ESCO skill annotations. This allows us to disentangle the impact of skill quality from the effectiveness of skill integration.
Surprisingly, our results show that none of these settings yield substantial improvements over strong text-only baselines . Even when using ground-truth skills, gains remain marginal and inconsistent. This finding challenges the common assumption that explicit skill modeling inherently provides complementary signal for CPP.
To better understand this result, we perform an in-depth analysis and identify three key factors. First, we observe a high degree of redundancy between textual and skill representations, suggesting that modern text embeddings already encode much of the relevant skill information. Second, we find that skill embeddings exhibit limited discriminative power, often collapsing into coarse occupational clusters. Third, we show that improvements from skill-based signals occur primarily in lower-ranked predictions, while degrading performance in the most critical top-k region.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们退一步,严格审查这一假设。 我们不注重改进技能提取,而是提出一个更根本的问题:明确的技能表述是否真正改善了职业路径预测,如果不是,为什么它们不能提供补充信号? 为此,我们对多种技能来源和一体化战略进行了系统研究。 具体而言,我们评价两种环境:(1) 从职业中推断出的预测技能;(2) 地面真实的ESCO技能说明。 这使得我们可以将技能质量的影响与技能整合的有效性分开。
令人惊讶的是,我们的结果表明,所有这些环境都比强有力的文本基线没有带来实质性改善。 即使在使用地面真实技能时,收益仍然微不足道和不一致。 这一结论对共同的假设提出了质疑,即明确的技能模型本质上为CPP提供了补充信号。
为了更好地理解这一结果,我们进行了深入分析,并确定了三个主要因素。 首先,我们看到文字表述和技能表述之间的高度冗余,这表明现代文本嵌入了大部分相关的技能信息。 第二,我们发现,技能嵌入显示出的歧视性力量有限,往往会沦为粗糙的职业集群。 第三,我们显示,技能信号的改进主要发生在排名较低的预测中,同时在最关键的顶级地区降低性能。

blocks.en: Taken together, our findings suggest that the limited effectiveness of skill-enhanced CPP is not merely due to imperfect skill extraction, but reflects a more fundamental issue in how skills are represented and utilized in current models. This has important implications for the design of skill-aware recommender systems and calls for a re-evaluation of how structured knowledge is integrated with dense representations.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的调查结果表明,提高技能的CPP的有效性有限,不仅仅是由于不完善的技能提炼,而是反映了在目前模式中如何体现和利用技能这一更根本的问题。 这对设计技能意识推荐人系统有重要影响,要求重新评价结构化知识如何与密集的表述相结合.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Career Path Prediction
blocks.zh: 2.1 职业路径预测

blocks.en: Career path prediction has evolved from structured sequence modeling toward text-based representation learning. Earlier work uses structured representations such as occupation graphs, skill graphs, factorization models, and recurrent sequence models to capture transitions between jobs ( de Groot et al., 2021 ; Gugnani et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2017 ; Cerilla et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2021 ; Schellingerhout et al., 2022 ) . More recent work has shifted toward textual occupation representations and retrieval-based formulations of CPP ( Decorte et al., 2023 ; Senger et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 职业路径预测已从结构化的序列模型演变为基于文本的代表性学习。 早期的工作使用结构化的表示,如职业图,技能图,指数化模型,以及重复序列模型来捕捉工作之间的过渡(de Groot等人,2021年;Gugnani等人,2018年;Li等人,2017年;Cerilla等人,2023年;张等人,2021年;Schellingerhout等人,2022年). 最近的工作已转向CPP的文字职业表述和基于检索的配方(Decorte等人,2023年;Senger等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Skills are widely regarded as a natural bridge between candidate profiles and occupational requirements, motivating their integration into career and job recommendation systems Decorte et al. (2023) ; Guan et al. (2024) . Prior work shows that career trajectories encode latent preferences beyond current qualifications ( Gong et al., 2024 ) , while skill-aware representation learning improves the modeling of occupational similarity and person-job fit ( Guan et al., 2024 ; Gugnani and Misra, 2020 ) . Furthermore, Zadykian et al. (2025) demonstrate that exploiting the ESCO skill hierarchy through graph neural networks improves job-title matching, suggesting that taxonomic skill information provides complementary signal beyond text embeddings. Most closely related to our work, Decorte et al. (2023) combine text-based career representations with ESCO skill-overlap features and report improvements over text-only models. However, their evaluation assumes pre-mapped ESCO occupations rather than free-text career histories. Building on the text-only system of Senger et al. (2025) , we examine whether skill integration yields consistent gains under more realistic grounding conditions across two benchmark datasets.
blocks.zh: 技能被广泛视为候选人简介与职业要求之间的自然桥梁,促使他们融入职业和职业推荐系统 Decorte et al. (2023); Guan et al. (2024). 以往的工作表明,职业轨迹编码了超越现有资格的潜在偏好(Gong等人,2024年),而技能意识的代表学习则改进了职业相似性模式和适合个人工作(Gugnani和Misra,2020年)。 此外,Zadykian等人(2025年)表明,通过图神经网络利用ESCO技能等级可以改善职称匹配,表明分类技能信息提供了超越文本嵌入的补充信号. 与我们的工作关系最密切的Decorte等人. (2023年)将基于文本的职业表述与ESCO技能重叠特征结合起来,并报告相对于仅文本模式的改进. 然而,他们的评价假设的是预选ESCO职业,而不是自由文字的职业历史。 在Senger等人(2025年)的仅文本系统的基础上,我们审查在两个基准数据集中,技能整合是否在更现实的基础上取得一致的收益。

blocks.en: 2.2 Skill Extraction and Grounding
blocks.zh: 2.2 技术采掘和地面

blocks.en: Mapping free-text job information to standardized taxonomies is a core challenge in labor market analysis. Rather than extracting explicit skill mentions from text, grounding-based approaches retrieve the most semantically similar ESCO occupations or skills for a given job title and description, leveraging dense retrieval models fine-tuned on occupation-skill corpora. TalentCLEF 2025 Gasco et al. (2025) provides a shared task benchmark covering both job-to-occupation and job-to-skill mapping, with top-performing systems demonstrating that retrieval-based grounding achieves competitive results on ESCO standardization. However, grounding quality remains imperfect — even state-of-the-art systems score below 0.5 MAP on skill matching Vachharajani (2025) — which directly limits the quality of skills available for downstream tasks such as CPP. Our pipeline adopts this grounding-based paradigm, combining job-to-occupation and job-to-skill retrieval with hierarchical fusion over ESCO’s taxonomic structure.
blocks.zh: 将自由文本工作信息映射到标准化分类是劳动力市场分析的一个核心挑战。 基础方法没有从文本中提取明确的技能,而是为特定职称和说明检索最相似的职业或技能,利用密集的检索模式对职业技能公司进行精细调整。 人才CLEF 2025 Gasco等人(2025年)提供了一个共同的任务基准,涵盖从工作到职业和从工作到技能的绘图,业绩最好的系统表明,基于检索的地基在ESCO标准化方面取得了竞争性结果。 然而,基础质量仍然不完善——甚至最先进的系统在技术匹配Vachharajani(2025年)上得分低于0.5 MAP,这直接限制了CPP等下游任务的可用技能质量. 我们的管道采用了这种基于基础的范式,将从职业到职业的回收和从职业到技能的回收与ESCO的分类结构的分级融合结合起来。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We treat CPP as an occupation-ranking task over ESCO. Given a time-ordered career history, where each experience contains a job title and optionally a description, the model ranks candidate ESCO occupations according to their likelihood of being the next occupation. We treat skill inference as a retrieval problem over ESCO skills: for each job experience, the system ranks skills that are likely to be relevant. ESCO distinguishes between essential and optional skills; we consider both as positive skill evidence. Skill-enhanced CPP then evaluates whether adding predicted or oracle skills to text-based career representations improves the final occupation ranking. The following paragraphs describe the methods used to test this.
blocks.zh: 我们把CPP视为对ESCO的占领级任务. 考虑到按时间顺序排列的职业历史,每一次经历都包含一个职称和可选择的描述,该模型根据候选人ESCO职业成为下一个职业的可能性进行排名. 我们把技能推论视为与ESCO技能相比的检索问题:对于每一种工作经验,系统会排列可能相关的技能。 ESCO区分基本技能和可选技能;我们认为两者都是积极的技能证据。 然后,技能增强的CPP评价在基于文本的职业表述中增加预测或甲骨文技能是否改善了最终职业排名. 以下各段介绍测试这种方法的方法。

blocks.en: We adopt a multi-step retrieval pipeline grounded in the ESCO taxonomy, building on the job-to-skill and job-to-occupation retrieval tasks of TalentCLEF 2025 Gasco et al. (2025) . We first retrieve candidate ESCO skills for each job experience via dense semantic retrieval (job-to-skill matching). We then apply occupation-mediated filtering: job experiences are mapped to their most similar ESCO occupations, and the resulting occupation-skill associations constrain the candidate pool to domain-relevant skills. Finally, ISCO codes are predicted from free-text job representations using a trained neural classifier, and the predicted ISCO group distribution is used to reweight the filtered skill candidates, exploiting the hierarchical structure of the taxonomy. This configuration was selected after comparing it against simpler alternatives: direct retrieval alone substantially underperforms (MAP 0.157), occupation-mediated filtering alone already recovers most of the gain (MAP 0.408–0.428 depending on the grounding encoder), and ISCO-weighted reweighting adds a further, smaller improvement (MAP up to 0.452). Building on this pipeline, we evaluate multiple skill prediction variants to analyze how skill prediction quality affects downstream CPP performance.
blocks.zh: 我们采用基于ESCO分类学的多步骤检索管道,利用TalentCLEF 2025 Gasco等人(2025年)的工作与技能及工作与职业检索任务。 我们首先通过密集语义检索(工作与技能匹配),为每个工作经历检索候选人ESCO技能。 然后,我们采用职业中介过滤法:将工作经验映射到最相似的ESCO职业,由此产生的职业技能协会将候选人库限制在与领域有关的技能上。 最后,职业分类代码是通过使用训练有素的神经分类器的自由文字工作说明来预测的,而预测的职业分类分组分布则用于重新对被过滤的技能候选人进行加权,利用分类学的等级结构. 这种配置是在与较简单的替代品进行比较后选定的:直接检索本身的绩效严重不足(MAP 0.157),仅职业中介过滤就已经恢复了大部分收益(MAP 0.408-0.428,取决于地面编码),职业分类加权重新加权增加了一个进一步的、较小的改进(MAP 高达0.452)。 在这个管道的基础上,我们评价多种技能预测变量,分析技能预测质量如何影响下游CPP性能.

blocks.en: We build on the strong text-only MLP of Senger et al. (2025) as our baseline, which encodes career histories via a sentence transformer and ranks candidate ESCO occupations by cosine similarity. We investigate several strategies for incorporating predicted skill information into this framework, ranging from score fusion to neural architectures.
blocks.zh: 我们以Senger等人(2025年)的强有力的仅文本的MLP作为我们的基线,它通过一个句子变换器编码职业历史,并以同位素相似性对候选人ESCO职业进行排序。 我们调查了将预测的技能信息纳入这一框架的若干战略,从积分聚变到神经结构。

blocks.en:
Following Decorte et al. (2023) , we implement a skill overlap baseline that measures the fraction of a target occupation’s ESCO-defined skills covered by the predicted skills accumulated across the candidate’s career history. This provides an explicit skill alignment signal independent of text-based representations.
We combine this signal with the text-based model score using two fusion strategies: linear interpolation (similar to Decorte et al. (2023) ) and multiplicative reweighting. Fusion hyperparameters are selected via grid search on the validation set, optimising for MRR.
blocks.zh:
继Decorte等人(2023年)之后,我们实施了一个技能重叠基准,以衡量在候选人职业生涯中积累的预测技能所涵盖的目标职业ESCO界定技能的一小部分。 这提供了一个独立于文本表述的明确的技能协调信号。
我们利用两种聚变策略将这个信号与基于文本的模型分数结合起来:线性插值(类似于Decorte等人(2023年))和多重重置. Fusion超参数仪在验证集上通过网格搜索选择,优化MRR.

blocks.en: We extend the strong text-only MLP baseline with skill-aware variants, exploring two orthogonal design dimensions: how skills are encoded, and how they are fused with career text representations.
blocks.zh: 我们用技能感知的变体来扩展仅强力文本的MLP基线,探索两个正统设计维度:技能是如何编码的,以及技能如何与职业文本表述的结合.

blocks.en: Regarding how skills are encoded, we evaluate two alternative approaches to encode skills into a single representation. Skill pooling encodes each predicted skill independently via a pretrained sentence transformer and aggregates them into a single embedding via weighted pooling across the career history, where weights reflect retrieval confidence, skill specificity (IDF scores), and job recency (logarithmic job-order decay). Skill concatenation instead joins the top- k k predicted skills into a single string and encodes it in one pass, allowing the encoder to capture inter-skill relationships within context.
blocks.zh: 关于技能是如何编码的,我们评价两种将技能编码为单一代表的替代办法。 技能集合通过预先训练的句子变压器独立地将每种预测技能编码,并通过加权集合在整个职业生涯过程中将其聚合成单一嵌入,其中的权重反映了检索信心,技能特异性(IDF分数),以及职务复发性(逻辑职务序列衰减). Skill concatenation转而将顶级-k k预测技能组合成单一的字符串,并编码成一个通过,使编码器能够在上下文中捕捉技能间的关系.

blocks.en: Both strategies are combined with the career text embedding using either early fusion, concatenating both embeddings into a single MLP input, or late fusion, where separate MLP stacks process each modality independently before a shared projection layer. All models are trained using cosine similarity against target occupation embeddings.
blocks.zh: 这两种策略都与职业文本相结合,要么采用早期聚变,将两种嵌入到单一的 MLP 输入中,要么采用晚聚变,在共享投影层之前分别的 MLP 堆栈独立处理每种模式. 所有模型都使用同位素相似性对目标占领嵌入进行训练。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate our approach on two publicly available datasets linked to the ESCO taxonomy: DECORTE Decorte et al. (2023) and KARRIEREWEGE+ Senger et al. (2025) . Both datasets provide career histories mapped to standardized ESCO occupation labels.
We primarily report results on DECORTE, as it includes human-written free-text job descriptions and therefore better reflects real-world resume data. The dataset contains 2,164 career histories with 9,885 job experiences mapped to 1,155 unique ESCO occupations. We use the official train/validation/test splits and follow prior work by augmenting training data with sub-sequences of career histories. KARRIEREWEGE+ provides a complementary larger-scale dataset built from anonymized German employment records; career trajectories are real, but job titles and descriptions are synthetically generated to provide free-text input. It comprises 99,997 career histories with 502,641 job experiences mapped to 1,189 unique ESCO occupations, used to assess generalisability.
blocks.zh:
我们评价我们有关ESCO分类法的两个公开数据集的方法: 发 交 Decorte等人(2023年)和KARRIEREWEGE+Senger等人(2025年). 这两套数据集都提供了职业历史图,标注了ESCO标准化职业标签。
我们主要报告DECORTE的结果,因为它包括人文的自由文本职务说明,因此更好地反映现实世界恢复数据。 该数据集包含2 164个职业经历,其中9 885个工作经历被绘制为1 155个独特的ESCO职业。 我们使用正式的列车/验证/测试拆分并跟踪先前的工作,通过职业历史的子序列来增加培训数据。 KARRIEREWEGE+提供了从无名化的德国就业记录中构建的辅助性更大的数据集;职业轨迹是真实的,但职称和描述是合成生成的,以提供自由文本输入. 它由99 997个职业史组成,502 641个工作经验被绘制成1 189个独特的ESCO职业,用于评估通用性。

blocks.en: The ESCO taxonomy serves both as the label space for occupation prediction and as the source of skill information. It contains over 3,000 occupations and nearly 14,000 skills, linked through essential and optional relations. Following prior work, we treat both relation types as positive signals.
blocks.zh: ESCO分类法既是职业预测的标签空间,也是技能信息的来源。 它包含3 000多个职业和近14 000个技能,通过基本和可选关系联系在一起。 继先前的工作之后,我们把两种关系类型都视为正信号。

blocks.en: We evaluate CPP with Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and Recall@ k k , standard ranking metrics that capture top-rank precision and whether the target appears among the top- k k recommendations. Skill prediction is evaluated with Mean Average Precision (MAP), which captures ranking quality across the full set of relevant skills.
blocks.zh: 我们用平均对等排名(MRR)和Recall@k k 来评价CPP,标准排名衡量标准能捕捉到排名最高的精确度,目标是否出现在排名最高的-k 建议中. 技能预测以平均精度(MAP)来评价,它掌握了整个相关技能组的排名质量。

blocks.en: In the text-based framework of Senger et al. (2025) , each job experience is formatted as a concatenation of title and description, encoded using MPNet-Decorte , 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/ElenaSenger/career-path-representation-mpnet-decorte a sentence transformer Reimers and Gurevych (2019) contrastively trained on free-text career data. An MLP maps career history embeddings to occupation embeddings; candidate occupations are ranked at inference by cosine similarity against precomputed ESCO occupation embeddings. For all runs, we use batch size 16, learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} , hidden dimension 512, single hidden layer, and dropout 0.1, trained with Cosine Embedding Loss and early stopping (patience 2) on validation loss; this configuration follows Senger et al. (2025) , as deeper networks consistently underperformed in preliminary experiments. Training data is augmented with contiguous career path sub-sequences of minimum length 2. We evaluate on both the augmented test split ( N = 1,802 N{=}1{,}802 ) and the original clean split ( N = 227 N{=}227 ).
blocks.zh: 在Senger等人(2025年)的基于文本的框架中,每种工作经历都采用标题和描述的组合形式,使用MPNet-Decorte编码,2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/ElenaSenger/carer-path-presentation-mpnet-decorte a句子变换器Reimers和Gurevich(2019年)对比性地接受了自由文本职业数据培训. 一种MLP地图将职业历史嵌入职业嵌入;候选职业通过对预算的ESCO职业嵌入的同位素相似性进行推论排序. 对所有运行,我们使用批量大小16,学习率2×10−5 2×Times}10×5},隐藏尺寸512,单隐藏层,以及退出0.1,经过Cosine Embedding Loss(patience 2)的训练,在验证损失时提前停止(patience 2);这种配置遵循Senger等人(2025),因为深度网络在初步实验中一直表现不佳. 培训数据以最小长度的连成一体的职业路径子序列加以扩充 2. 我们评价扩大的试验分数(N=1,802 N{=}1{,}802)和原来的清洁分数(N=227 N{=}227)。

blocks.en: We evaluate our skill extraction pipeline (Section 3 ) on DECORTE using MAP, comparing direct job-to-skill retrieval against ISCO-weighted fusion variants. For downstream CPP experiments, we use the JobBERT-based ISCO-weighted fusion (H2, MAP 0.435), which yields better discriminative signal for occupation ranking than the highest-MAP configuration (JobGTE + H2, MAP 0.452). To disentangle skill quality from integration strategy, we additionally evaluate an oracle condition using skills derived from gold ESCO occupation labels, applied to the score fusion setting. We evaluate two integration strategies: (i) Score fusion , combining text-based and skill overlap scores with hyperparameters selected by grid search optimising for MRR; and (ii) Skill-enhanced neural models , extending the MLP with skill embeddings as described in Section 3 , with the best configuration further tuned using Optuna.
blocks.zh: 我们利用MAP评估我们关于DECORTE的技术提取管道(第3节),将直接工作与技能回收与职业分类加权聚变进行比较。 对于下游CPP实验,我们使用基于JobBERT的ISCO加权聚变(H2,MAP 0.435),它产生比最高的MAP配置(JobGTE + H2,MAP 0.452)更好的职业排名区分信号. 为了将技能质量与融合战略区分开来,我们利用来自金质ESCO职业标签的技能,进一步评估甲骨文条件,并应用于积分组合设定。 我们评价两个整合战略:(一) 分数组合,将基于文本的和技能的重合分数与优化MR的网格搜索所选择的超参数合并;(二) 增强技能的神经模型,如第3节所述,用技能嵌入法扩展MLP,最佳配置进一步调整使用Optuna。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Text-Only Baseline
blocks.zh: 5.1 仅限文本基线

blocks.en:
On DECORTE, we first reproduce the text-only baseline from Senger et al. (2025) , achieving comparable performance (MRR 0.266 vs. 0.256 reported); corresponding results on KARRIEREWEGE+ follow in Section 5.4 .
Including job descriptions improves performance over titles alone (MRR 0.266 vs. 0.224), highlighting the importance of richer textual context. Results on the clean test split are slightly higher in MRR (0.276 vs. 0.266) and R@5 (0.374 vs. 0.356), but show lower recall at larger cutoff (R@10 0.414 vs. 0.420, from Table 1 ).
blocks.zh:
在DECORTE上,我们首先转载了Senger等人的文本基准。 关于KARRIEREWEGE+的相应结果见第5.4节。
包括职务说明可以改善单是职称的业绩(MRR 0.266 vs. 0.224),突出了更丰富的文字背景的重要性. 在MRR(0.276 vs.0.266)和R@5(0.374 vs.0.356)中,清洁测试分拆的结果略高,但在较大的截断时显示收缩率较低(R@100.414 vs.0.420,见表1 )。

blocks.en: 5.2 Skill Overlap Scoring
blocks.zh: 5.2 技能重叠

blocks.en:
We evaluate skill overlap both as a standalone signal and in combination with text-based predictions.
Using ground-truth ESCO skills as an oracle yields substantially lower performance than the text-only model (MRR 0.198 vs. 0.266). Using predicted skills further reduces performance, with direct retrieval performing poorly due to noise.
blocks.zh:
我们评价技能的重叠,既是作为独立的信号,又是与基于文本的预测相结合的。
将地面真实的ESCO技能作为甲骨文,其性能大大低于只使用文字的模型(MRR 0198 vs. 0.266)。 使用预测技能会进一步降低性能,由于噪音,直接检索表现不佳.

blocks.en: Applying filtering and taxonomic fusion improves skill-based scoring, with the best configuration approaching oracle performance. However, all variants remain below the text-only baseline. When combined with text-based predictions, skill overlap provides no measurable improvement. Fusion methods consistently assign negligible weight to the skill component.
blocks.zh: 应用过滤和分类聚变可以提高基于技能的评分,最佳配置接近甲骨文性能. 然而,所有变体仍低于仅限文本的基线。 与基于文本的预测相结合,技能重叠并不能提供可衡量的改进。 融合方法始终使技能部分的重量微不足道。

blocks.en: 5.3 Skill-Enhanced Neural Models
blocks.zh: 5.3 技能增强神经模型

blocks.en: We evaluate MLP models augmented with skill representations, varying both the skill integration method (pooling vs. concatenation) and the fusion architecture (early vs. late), as described in Section 3 . Table 1 reports results for the best configuration of each integration method.
blocks.zh: 正如第3节所描述的那样,我们评价了以技能表示方式扩充的MLP模型,这些模型既改变了技能整合方法(集合与凝聚),也改变了聚变结构(早期与晚期)。 表1报告了每种整合方法的最佳配置。

blocks.en: Overall, skill-enhanced models achieve only marginal improvements over the text-only baseline. On the augmented test split, differences are negligible (MRR 0.270 vs. 0.266). On the clean split, gains are somewhat larger (up to MRR 0.287 with log-weighted pooling), but correspond to only a handful of additional correct predictions given the smaller sample size ( N = 227 N{=}227 ).
blocks.zh: 总体而言,技能增强模型仅比文本基准实现微小改进。 在扩大的试验分数上,差异可忽略不计(MRR 0.270 vs.0.266)。 在净分法上,增益略大(最多为MRR 0.287,加上对数加权集合),但考虑到样本规模较小(N=227 N{=}227),只对应少数额外的正确预测.

blocks.en: Comparing integration methods, skill pooling consistently outperforms concatenation on MRR (0.270 vs. 0.262 augmented; 0.283 vs. 0.278 clean), while concatenation achieves the better R@10 (0.449 vs. 0.427 clean). This suggests skills can occasionally help recover the correct occupation at lower ranks, but do not sharpen top-1 predictions, consistent with the redundancy we examine in Section 6 .
blocks.zh: 比较整合方法,技能集成在MRR上的表现始终高于凝聚(0.270对0.262增强;0.283对0.278清洁),而凝聚则达到更好的R@10(0.449对0.427清洁)。 这说明技能偶尔可以帮助在低级别恢复正确的职业,但不会像我们在第6节中审查的冗余情况那样,使顶级1级的预测更加清晰。

blocks.en: Fusion architecture (early vs. late) and encoder choice have comparatively little effect: differences between configurations within each integration method are within 0.01 MRR, smaller than the gap between integration methods themselves. Task-specific skill encoders ( pjmath-BGE ) modestly outperform general-purpose alternatives, but all configurations remain close to the text-only baseline.
blocks.zh: Fusion架构(早期 vs. late)和编码器选择效果相对较小:每个集成方法内部的配置差异在0.01 MRR范围内,小于集成方法本身之间的差距. 任务特定技能编码器(pjmath-BGE)的性能略高于通用替代品,但所有配置仍然接近仅文本基准.

blocks.en: Across configurations, results are largely stable: • Different encoders yield similar performance, with slight advantages for task-specific models. • Early and late fusion architectures perform comparably. • Pooling and weighting strategies have minimal impact.
blocks.zh: 纵观配置,结果基本稳定: • 不同的编码器产生相似的性能,对任务特定模型略有优势. • 早期和晚期聚变结构的性能相当。 • 集合和加权战略的影响很小。

blocks.en: Different encoders yield similar performance, with slight advantages for task-specific models.
blocks.zh: 不同的编码器产生相似的性能,对于任务特定模型来说略有优势.

blocks.en: Early and late fusion architectures perform comparably.
blocks.zh: 早期和晚期的聚变结构具有类似的性能.

blocks.en: Pooling and weighting strategies have minimal impact.
blocks.zh: 集合和加权战略的影响很小。

blocks.en: Table 1: Skill-enhanced MLP results, by skill integration method. For each method, the best-performing configuration is reported.
blocks.zh: 表1:按技能整合方法分列的技能强化的MLP结果。 每种方法都报告最佳的配置。

blocks.en: 5.4 Scalability on Larger Data
blocks.zh: 5.4 大数据上的可扩展性

blocks.en: To assess whether our findings generalize beyond DECORTE, we extend evaluation to KARRIEREWEGE+, which is ∼ \sim 40 × \times larger ( N ≈ 100,000 N{\approx}100{,}000 career histories) but uses LLM-paraphrased synthetic descriptions rather than free text. Since dataset size and text type differ simultaneously, this comparison indicates whether the pattern holds at scale rather than isolating the effect of scale itself.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的结论是否超越DECORTE,我们把评价扩大到KARRIEREWEGE+,这是\sim 40\\tims 更大的(N ~ 100 000 N \ 大约}100{,}000 职业历史),但使用LLM 参数的合成描述而不是自由文本。 由于数据集的大小和文本类型同时不同,这一比较表明该模式是否具有规模,而不是孤立规模本身的影响.

blocks.en: Absolute performance is substantially higher than on DECORTE (text-only MRR 0.439 vs. 0.266), likely reflecting easier career trajectories in KARRIEREWEGE+, where transitions remain within the same occupation more often than in DECORTE ( Senger et al., 2025 ) . Skill enhancement again yields only marginal gains: concatenation improves MRR by 0.5% (0.441 vs. 0.439) on the augmented split and 1.2% (0.508 vs. 0.502) on clean, while pooling shows no improvement. Both effects are smaller than on DECORTE (+1.5% and +4.0% respectively), suggesting that skill redundancy is, if anything, more pronounced with synthetic text. As on DECORTE, hybrid fusion of text and skill-overlap scores converges to fully ignoring the skill component ( α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 ), confirming that skill-based scoring provides no complementary signal at this scale either.
blocks.zh: 绝对性能大大高于DECORTE(仅文本MRR 0.439 vs. 0.266),可能反映KARRIEREWEGE+的较易职业轨迹,在KARRIEREWEGE+,过渡在同一个职业中的情况比DECORTE(Senger等人,2025年)更为常见。 技能增强再次只产生边际收益:在扩大的拆分上,集成率提高0.5%(0.441对0.439),在清洁上提高1.2%(0.508对0.502),而集成率没有显示改善。 这两种效果都小于对DECORTE的影响(分别为+1.5%和+4.0%),表明技能冗余(如果有的话)与合成文本相比更为明显. 与DECORTE一样,文本和技能重叠分数的混合组合会完全忽略技能部分(α = 1.0\alpha= 1.0),确认基于技能的积分在这一尺度上也没有提供互补信号.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: This section examines why skill integration yields limited gains, analyzing prediction scores, embedding representations, and a structural limitation in skill attribution. Across these analyses, a consistent picture emerges: the limited effect of skill integration is not an artifact of model architecture or skill prediction quality, but reflects a deeper redundancy between textual and skill-based signals.
blocks.zh: 本节探讨为什么技能整合收益有限、分析预测分数、嵌入表述以及技能归属的结构限制。 在这些分析中,出现了一个一致的情景:技能整合的有限效果不是模型结构或技能预测质量的产物,而是反映了文字信号和基于技能的信号之间更深层次的冗余.

blocks.en: 6.1 Signal Redundancy
blocks.zh: 6.1 信号冗余

blocks.en: To understand why skill enhancement fails to improve aggregate performance, we examine the relationship between text-based and skill-based prediction signals. For each test sample, we compute the Spearman correlation Spearman (1904) between the ranking scores produced by the text-only and skill-only models across all candidate occupations. The mean correlation is 0.79 (median 0.84), indicating that the two modalities share roughly 80% of their ranking signal. This redundancy explains why explicitly adding skill information provides limited complementary value: contrastively-trained text encoders already capture much of what predicted skills offer.
blocks.zh: 为了理解技能增强为何不能改善总体性能,我们研究了基于文本的预测信号与基于技能的预测信号之间的关系. 对于每个测试样本,我们计算Spearman相关的Spearman(1904年)在所有候选职业的文本模式和技能模式产生的排名分数之间. 平均相关性为0.79(中位数0.84),表明两种模式共享其排名信号的大约80%. 这种冗余性解释了为什么明确添加技能信息能提供有限的补充价值:反之,训练有素的文本编码器已经掌握了大部分预测的技能。

blocks.en: Contingency analysis of top-1 correctness reinforces this picture. The two models agree in 90.9% of cases (both correct: 12.4%; both incorrect: 78.5%); text-only corrects the skill-only model’s errors in 6.2% of samples, while the reverse occurs in only 2.9%. This 2.9% represents the maximum achievable improvement from skill integration under any fusion strategy, and is consistent with the marginal gains observed. Where models disagree, text-only is also more reliable (10.5% vs. 5.0% accuracy on the disagreement set), so a hybrid model correctly defers to text-based signal in most conflict cases. This deference extends to candidate selection itself: across k ∈ { 5 , 10 , 20 } k\in\{5,10,20\} , the hybrid model’s candidate sets consistently align more closely with text-only (63.0–66.5% Jaccard overlap) than with skill-only (45.8–51.0%), confirming that score fusion draws its predictions predominantly from the text modality regardless of cutoff.
blocks.zh: 对顶级1级正确性的应急分析强化了这一情况。 两种模式在90.9%的案例中一致(两者都正确:12.4%;两者都不正确:78.5%);只有文本才能纠正6.2%的样本中只有技能模式的错误,而反之只有2.9%。 这2.9%是任何聚变战略下从技能整合中实现的最大可实现的改进,与观察到的边际收益是一致的。 在模型不同意的情况下,只文本也比较可靠(10.5%对分歧集的精确度为5.0%),因此混合模型在大多数冲突情况下都正确地服从基于文本的信号. 这种尊重延伸到候选人选择本身:在K {{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{}、10{{{{}K\\in 5、10、20{}之间,混合模式的候选人组合与仅文本(63.0–66.5 % Jacard重叠)一致,而不是只技能(45.8–51.0%),确认分数组合主要从文本模式中得出预测,而不论截止日期。

blocks.en: Redundancy is not uniform across all cases, however. Stratifying by career trajectory type (Table 4 ) shows that skill enhancement provides its largest benefit for regressions, i.e., transitions from managerial to non-managerial roles ( + 0.020 +0.020 MRR)—the only trajectory type with a clear positive effect, plausibly because shifting skill profiles signal downward mobility that text alone underrepresents. This benefit is confined to a small subset (13.8% of samples), however, and is offset by slight degradation on the dominant lateral transitions (78.6%), as well as on occupations with distinctive skill profiles more broadly, such as Cooks (+0.185 MRR).
blocks.zh: 然而,在所有情况下,裁员并不统一。 按职业轨迹类型划分(表4)表明,技能增强为回归提供了最大的好处,即从管理角色向非管理角色的过渡(+0.020+0.020 MRR)——这是唯一一种具有明显积极影响的轨迹类型,其合理原因是,技能配置的转变表明文本本身的向下流动。 然而,这一福利仅限于一小部分(13.8%的样本),但主要横向过渡(78.6%)以及技能特征较广泛的职业(如厨师(+0.185 MRR))。

blocks.en: 6.2 Discriminative Power and Confident-Prediction Disruption
blocks.zh: 6.2 歧视性权力和自信的破坏

blocks.en: Beyond aggregate redundancy, we examine whether skill-only predictions are well-calibrated, i.e., whether the margin between the top- and second-ranked candidate reliably signals correctness. Skill-only trails text-only on accuracy (0.154 vs. 0.186), mean margin (0.057 vs. 0.065), and calibration correlation between margin and correctness (0.213 vs. 0.276). As Figure 1 shows, skill-only margins concentrate narrowly around 0.05 regardless of outcome, while text-only exhibits a flatter distribution with clearer separation between correct and incorrect predictions.
blocks.zh: 除了总冗余外,我们还要研究只掌握技能的预测是否得到很好的校准,即排名最高和排名第二的候选人之间的差额是否可靠地表示正确。 只有技能的线索只涉及精度(0.154对0.186),平均比值(0.057对0.065),以及比值与正确度的校准相关性(0.213对0.276). 如图1所示,无论结果如何,只掌握技能的边距都集中在0.05左右,而只显示文字的分布,更明确地区分正确和不正确的预测。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Discriminative power analysis via score margins ( M = s t ​ o ​ p − 1 − s t ​ o ​ p − 2 M=s_{top-1}-s_{top-2} ). Distributions show the density of correct predictions (green) versus incorrect ones (red) for Text, Skill, and Hybrid models. A higher margin for correct predictions indicates superior calibration and decision certainty. The sharper separation in the Text-only model signifies higher discriminative power, whereas the overlap in the Skill-only model suggests lower certainty in distinguishing between occupational classes.
blocks.zh: 图1:通过分数比值(M = s t o p − 1 - s o p − 2 M = s_{top-1} - s_{top-2})进行的差别力分析 分布显示Text, Skill, 和混合模型的正确预测(绿色)与错误预测(红色)的密度. 正确预测的幅度较大,表明校准和决定的确定性较高。 单文本模式中更严格的分离意味着更大的歧视力量,而只技能模式中的重叠表明区分职业类别的确定性较低。

blocks.en: This has a concrete effect on performance: skill enhancement tends to hurt cases where the text encoder is already confident. When the target occupation matches the most recent one (same-role continuation, N = 290 N{=}290 ), text-only alone already reaches MRR 0.713, yet skill enhancement lowers performance here ( − 0.013 -0.013 MRR, − 1.4 % -1.4\% R@1). On the harder and far more common role-change scenario ( N = 1,512 N{=}1{,}512 ), the benefit is marginal ( + 0.002 +0.002 MRR). Because straightforward cases make up most of the test set, this pattern anticipates the rank-movement results below: skill enhancement disrupts predictions the text model is already getting right.
blocks.zh: 这对性能有具体的影响:技能提升往往会伤害文本编码器已经有信心的案例. 当目标职业与最近的职业相匹配时(相同作用的续作,N=290 N{=}290),仅文本就已经达到MRR 0.713,但技能增强会降低这里的性能(0.013 - 0.013 MRR,−1.4 % -1.4\% R@1). 在更难和更常见的角色变化情景(N=1,512 N{=}1{,}512)上,好处是边际的(+0.002+0.002 MRR). 由于直截了当的案例占了测试集的大部分,这种模式预计到以下的排名运动结果:技能增强干扰了文本模型已经得到正确的预测.

blocks.en: 6.3 The Rank Movement Paradox
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 军衔运动

blocks.en: This disruption pattern is visible at the rank level as well: tracking how skill integration moves the rank of the correct occupation reveals where these effects occur. For each test sample, we compare the rank of the target occupation under the text-only and hybrid models (Figure 2 ). More samples improve (43.3%, average +55.4 positions) than degrade (32.1%, average − 39.1 -39.1 positions), which would suggest a net benefit.
blocks.zh: 这种中断模式在级别上也可见:跟踪技能整合如何移动正确职业的级别,揭示这些影响发生在何处. 对于每个测试样本,我们比较仅文本模型和混合模型下的目标占领的等级(图2 ). 样本改善(43.3%),平均+55.4位)多于降解(32.1%,平均−39.1-39.1位),这意味着净效益。

blocks.en: The two types of movement, however, occur in different regions of the ranking, so this apparent advantage does not translate into metric gains. Improvements typically lift the target from very low ranks (e.g., position 500 to 450), which affects neither MRR nor Recall@ k k . Degradations, by contrast, cluster near the top of the ranking (e.g., position 8 to 12, or 1 to 3), directly harming both metrics. Skill enhancement therefore tends to help in metric-insensitive regions while occasionally disrupting confident, high-ranked predictions—explaining the paradox of more rank improvements than degradations without any corresponding aggregate gain.
blocks.zh: 然而,两类移动发生在排名不同的区域,因此这种明显的优势并没有转化为衡量收益. 改进通常会使目标从非常低的级别升起(如位置500到450),这既不影响MRR,也不影响Recall@ k k k. 相形之下,群落接近排名的顶端(如位置8至12,或1至3),直接损害两个度量. 因此,技能提高往往有助于对指标不敏感的区域,同时偶尔会破坏信心高的预测——解释提高等级比退化多的悖论,而没有相应的总收益。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Rank dynamics between text-only and hybrid models. (A) Frequency of improved vs. degraded samples by initial rank bucket. (B) Distribution of rank displacement magnitude. Degradations concentrate in high-rank buckets (1–10) but are individually small; improvements occur mainly in low-rank buckets and involve larger shifts that are metric-insensitive.
blocks.zh: 图 2:单文本模式与混合模式之间的排名动态. (A) 初始排位桶的改进样品与退化样品的频率。 (B) 级别流离失所幅度的分布。 退化集中在高等级的桶(1至10个),但每个桶都很小;改善主要发生在低等级的桶中,涉及较大的班次,对尺度不敏感。

blocks.en: 6.4 Representational Collapse and Target Misalignment
blocks.zh: 6.4 代表性崩溃和目标错位

blocks.en: Table 2: PCA cumulative explained variance comparison between text and skill embeddings.
blocks.zh: 表2:五氯苯甲醚累积解释了文本与技能嵌入之间的比较差异。

blocks.en: A complementary explanation for skill enhancement’s limited effect lies in the geometry of the skill embeddings themselves. Text embeddings spread variance broadly across principal components ((Table 2 ; 38.6% explained by the top 10), while pooled skill embeddings concentrate variance sharply (76.2–80.0% in the top 10, depending on pooling strategy). Pairwise cosine similarity confirms this collapse — text embeddings average 0.072 similarity between distinct samples, while pooled skill embeddings average 0.88–0.91, meaning skill representations for different career histories are nearly indistinguishable from one another (Figure 3 ). Concatenated skill encoding partially mitigates this collapse (54.4% variance in top 10 components; mean pairwise similarity 0.655) but remains substantially less discriminative than text (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh: 技能增强作用有限的一个补充解释是技能嵌入本身的几何特征。 文字嵌入在主要组成部分之间分布很广(表2;38.6%由前10名解释),而集合技能嵌入则使差异急剧增加(前10名中占76.2-80.0%,取决于集合战略)。 平心而论的余弦相似性证实了这种崩溃——文字将不同样本之间的平均0.072相似性嵌入,而集合技能平均嵌入0.88-0.91,意思是不同职业历史的技能表现几乎无法区分(图3)。 复合技术编码部分缓解了这种崩溃(前10个组件54.4%的差异;平均对等性0.655),但与文本相比,差别仍然小得多(图4)。

blocks.en: This collapse compounds with redundancy: the mean cosine similarity between a career’s text and skill embedding is 0.397, indicating that a substantial share of the skill embedding’s content is already present in the text embedding. Finally, text embeddings are consistently closer to target occupation embeddings than skill embeddings (mean similarity 0.355 vs. 0.256), meaning text representations are simply better positioned in the latent space that ranking depends on. Together, these properties — low variance, redundancy with text, and weaker target alignment — explain why skill embeddings struggle to contribute discriminative signal regardless of integration strategy.
blocks.zh: 这种冗余的崩溃复合物:职业文本与技能嵌入之间的平均余弦相似性为0.397,表明技能嵌入内容的很大一部分已经存在于文本嵌入中。 最后,文本嵌入比技能嵌入更接近目标职业嵌入(平均相似度0.355对0.256),意思是文本表述在排序所依赖的潜在空间中更适合. 这些属性加在一起——差异小,与文字的冗余,以及目标对齐性较弱——解释了为什么无论融合战略如何,技能嵌入都为贡献歧视性信号而挣扎.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Pairwise cosine similarity and PCA projections for text vs. pooled skill embeddings. Pooled skill embeddings ( μ ≈ 0.90 \mu\approx 0.90 ) shift dramatically toward near-identical representations compared to text ( μ = 0.07 \mu=0.07 ); PCA projections show text embeddings spanning the latent space broadly while skill embeddings collapse into constrained, structured clusters.
blocks.zh: 图3:文本对集合技能嵌入的对等余弦相似性和五氯苯甲醚预测。 与文本(μ = 0.07\mu= 0.07)相比,组合技能嵌入(μ ^ 0.90\mu\\ 约 0.90)显著转向近似相同的表达方式; PCA预测显示,文本嵌入范围广泛跨越潜在空间,而技能嵌入则崩溃为受约束的、结构化的集群。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Pairwise cosine similarity and PCA projections for text vs. concatenated skill embeddings. Even after mitigating collapse via IDF-weighted concatenation ( μ = 0.66 \mu=0.66 ), the skill modality remains more concentrated than text ( μ = 0.07 \mu=0.07 ), lacking the same latent diversity.
blocks.zh: 图 4:对等余弦相似度和PAC预测的文本对调技能嵌入. 即使在通过以色列国防军加权结合(μ = 0.66\mu = 0.66)减轻崩溃后,技能模式仍然比文字(μ = 0.07\mu = 0.07)更集中,缺乏同样的潜在多样性。

blocks.en: 6.5 Skill Genericness and Sample Difficulty
blocks.zh: 6.5 技能通用性和样本难度

blocks.en: A counterintuitive pattern emerges when stratifying performance by skill genericness, computed as the normalized inverse document frequency of predicted skills in DECORTE. Career paths with more generic skills (e.g., manage budgets , manage staff ) achieve substantially higher accuracy across all models than those with specific skills (text-only Acc@1: 24.8% for the most generic quartile vs. 11.8% for the most specific), inverting the expected relationship in which specific skills should provide stronger discriminative signal (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 在按技能通用性划分业绩时会出现一种反直觉模式,按DECORTE预测技能的正常反向文件频率计算。 具有更多通用技能(例如管理预算、管理工作人员)的职业道路,在所有模式中,其准确度大大高于具有特定技能的职业道路(只有文字的Acc@1:最通用的四分法为24.8%,最具体的为11.8%),颠倒了预期的关系,在这种关系中,特定技能应提供更强有力的歧视性信号(表3)。

blocks.en: Table 3: Performance by skill genericness quartile (DECORTE-based IDF). Higher genericness correlates with better performance across all models, reflecting dataset composition rather than skill utility.
blocks.zh: 表3:按技能通用性分列的业绩(以DECORTE为基础的以色列国防军)。 通用性较高与所有模型的绩效较好有关,反映了数据集的组成,而不是技能效用。

blocks.en: This pattern is explained by dataset composition rather than skill utility: generic skills concentrate in well-represented occupation categories (e.g., Managers, Professionals) that dominate DECORTE, giving these career transitions more training examples and making them inherently easier to predict regardless of method. Correctly predicted samples have significantly lower genericness on average than incorrect ones across all models, including text-only (p <0.001), confirming that genericness is a proxy for sample difficulty rather than a property of skill usefulness. A similar pattern holds for skill prediction confidence: text-only and skill-only accuracy improve in parallel from low- to high-confidence quartiles, indicating that confidence, too, reflects how easy a sample is overall rather than the quality of the skill signal specifically.
blocks.zh: 这种模式是由数据集组成而不是技能效用所解释的:通用技能集中在占据DECORTE主导地位的任职人数充足的职业类别(例如管理人员、专业人员),使这些职业过渡有更多的培训实例,使其在本质上更容易预测,无论方法如何。 正确预测的样本平均通用性明显低于所有模型的不正确样本,包括仅文本(p < 0.001),确认通用性是样本难度的代称,而不是技能实用性属性. 技能预测信心的类似模式是:从低自信到高自信的四分位数平行提高文本唯一和技能唯一准确度,表明信心也反映了样本的总体便捷性,而不是具体反映技能信号的质量。

blocks.zh: 表4:按职业轨迹类型分列的技能增强效应。 Progression=目标为Manager,但最后的工作不是; Respression=最后的工作为Manager,但目标不是.

blocks.en: 6.6 The Grounding Assumption Limitation
blocks.zh: 6.6 假定理由的限制

blocks.en: A further limitation is structural rather than representational. Our skill prediction pipeline attributes skills at the occupation level: job titles are mapped to their most similar ESCO occupations, and skills are inherited from this prediction rather than extracted from the individual’s actual described competencies. Two individuals holding the same job title therefore receive identical predicted skill sets, even if their real career histories differ. This grounding assumption caps the ceiling on complementary signal independent of model quality. Even a perfect occupation classifier would only recover the skills associated with an occupation in general, not those specific to the individual.
blocks.zh: 另一个限制是结构性的而不是代表性的。 我们的技能预测将技能归结于职业层面:职称被绘制为最相似的ESCO职业,技能从这一预测中继承,而不是从个人实际描述的能力中提取。 因此,持有相同职称的两个人获得相同的预测技能组合,即使他们的实际职业经历不同。 这种定位假设将天花板限制在与模型质量无关的补充信号上。 即使是完美的职业分类人员,也只能恢复与一般职业有关的技能,而不是个人特有的技能。

blocks.en: This limitation is consistent with the rank movement findings in Section 6.3 : skill enhancement recovers targets from very low ranks but rarely sharpens discrimination among similar occupations in the critical top- k k region. Related occupations in ESCO share substantial skill overlap by construction, so occupation-level skill attribution may identify the correct general neighborhood while lacking the granularity to distinguish between close alternatives — precisely the distinction that MRR and Recall@ k k reward.
blocks.zh: 这一限制与第6.3节中的军衔调动结论是一致的:技能提高使目标从非常低的军衔中恢复,但很少加剧关键最高K区类似职业之间的歧视。 职业分类中的相关职业由于建筑而有相当程度的技能重叠,因此职业一级的技能归属可能识别出正确的一般邻里,同时缺乏区分近距离替代物的颗粒性——正是MRR和Recall@k k奖励的区别.

blocks.en: 6.7 Implications for Skill-Aware Recommender Design
blocks.zh: 6.7 对技能-软件建议设计的影响

blocks.en: Table 5: Skill enhancement effect by target ISCO-1 group (DECORTE test set). The four smallest ISCO-1 categories (Armed Forces, Agriculture, Craft & Trades, Machine Operators; 57 samples combined) are omitted due to insufficient sample size for reliable estimates.
blocks.zh: 表5:按目标ISCO-1组(DECORTE测试集)分列的技能增强效应. 四个最小的ISCO-1类别(武装部队、农业、手工业和贸易、机器操作员;57个样本加在一起)由于样本规模不足以进行可靠的估计而略去。

blocks.en: These findings suggest two practical takeaways for practitioners building skill-aware recommender systems. First, explicit skill features should not be assumed to improve performance uniformly; their utility varies by occupational category (Table 5 ), helping Professionals the most ( + 0.012 +0.012 MRR) while degrading Service & Sales ( − 0.028 -0.028 ). Checking redundancy at the category level, for instance via the score correlation introduced in Section 6.1 , is a cheap diagnostic before investing in skill-prediction infrastructure for a given domain. Second, since skill enhancement helps primarily in metric-insensitive regions of the ranking while occasionally harming high-confidence predictions (Section 6.3 ), selective integration that applies skill information only when textual confidence is low may be more productive than blanket fusion.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,实践者可采取两种实际的外购,建立技能意识推荐系统。 首先,不应以明确的技能特征来统一提高业绩;其效用因职业类别而异(表5),帮助专业人员最多(+0.012+0.012 MRR),同时降低服务和销售(−0.028-0.028)。 在类别一级检查冗余情况,例如通过第6.1节中引入的分数关联,是在对特定领域的技能预测基础设施进行投资之前的一种廉价诊断。 第二,由于技能提高主要有助于排名中不敏感的地区,同时偶尔损害高度自信的预测(第6.3节),只有在文字信心低的情况下才适用技能信息的选择性整合可能比一揽子组合更有成效。

blocks.en: 6.8 Comparison with Prior Literature
blocks.zh: 6.8 与以往文献的比较

blocks.en: Decorte et al. (2023) report a text-only baseline of MRR 0.247, improved to 0.274 by adding skill overlap. The text-only baseline we build on ( Senger et al., 2025 ) , which we reproduce at MRR 0.266, already exceeds their text-only result and approaches their skill-enhanced result without using any skill information. In addition, the two studies rely on different ESCO taxonomy versions (v1.1.2 vs. our v1.2.0), so the underlying occupation-skill associations are not directly comparable. Together, these differences suggest that skill contribution is highly sensitive to the strength of the text encoder and the taxonomy version used. Rather than being at odds with our findings, this pattern reinforces them: skill overlap appears to add value when the text representation leaves more headroom, and its contribution diminishes as the text encoder becomes more expressive, consistent with the redundancy we report in Section 6.1 .
blocks.zh: Decorte等人(2023年)报告只有文字基线0.247,通过增加技能重叠改进为0.274。 我们基于的仅文本基准(Senger等人,2025年),我们在0.266核磁共振中复制了该基准,该基准已经超过仅文本的结果,并在没有使用任何技能信息的情况下接近其技能增强的结果。 此外,这两项研究还依赖ESCO分类学的不同版本(v1.1.2 vs. our v1.2.0),因此基础职业技能协会没有直接可比性. 这些差异加在一起表明,技能贡献对文本编码器和所使用的分类学版本的强度高度敏感. 这种模式与其说与我们的调查结果不一致,不如说强化了这些结论:在文本表述离开更多的会议室时,技能重叠似乎会增加价值,而随着文本编码器的表达性增强,其贡献也会减少,这与我们在第6.1节中报告的冗余性是一致的。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: This study has three main limitations. First, we report single-run results without significance tests or variance estimates across random seeds, so small differences (e.g., 0.005–0.01 MRR) should be interpreted with caution. We mitigate this with an informal robustness argument: the same pattern, marginal and inconsistent gains from skill integration, holds across two datasets (DECORTE and KARRIEREWEGE+), multiple integration strategies (score fusion, skill pooling, skill concatenation), and both oracle and predicted skill conditions. This cross-setting consistency makes it unlikely that our central finding is an artifact of a single noisy run, though it does not substitute for formal statistical testing.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有三个主要局限。 首先,我们报告单一运行结果,但没有进行重大测试,也没有对随机种子进行差异估计,因此,应当谨慎地解释小差异(如0.005-0.01 MRR)。 我们用一种非正式的稳健性论点来缓解这一点:从技能整合中获得的相同模式、边际和不一致的收益,涉及两个数据集(DECORTE和KARRIEREWEGE+)、多重整合战略(核心聚合、技能集中、技能集中)以及甲骨文和预测的技能条件。 这种交叉设定的一致性使得我们的核心发现不可能是一次吵闹跑跑的一件文物,尽管它不能取代正式的统计测试.

blocks.en: Second, our oracle condition is evaluated primarily in the score fusion setting (Section 4). In early exploratory runs, we also combined oracle skills with a neural architecture using ESCO-grounded job representations, but observed no improvement, consistent with the circularity discussed in Section 6.6 : skills derived from the occupation label add little when the job representation already encodes that occupation. This motivated our focus on free-text job representations, where occupational identity is less deterministic and skill information has more room to contribute.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们的甲骨文状况主要在积分聚变设定中进行评估(第4节)。 在早期探索中,我们还将甲骨文技能与神经结构结合起来,使用ESCO基于工作说明书,但发现没有改进,这与第6.6节所讨论的循环一致:从职业标签中获取的技能在工作说明书已经编码该职业时几乎没有增加。 这促使我们把重点放在自由文本的工作说明上,因为在那里,职业身份不太具有决定性,技能信息有更大的贡献空间。

blocks.en: Third, our experiments build on a single text-only baseline architecture, the MLP model of Senger et al. (2025) . It remains an open question whether our findings generalize to other CPP architectures.
blocks.zh: 第三,我们的实验建立在单一文本唯一的基线架构之上,即Senger等人的MLP模型(2025年)。 我们的研究结果是否概括到其他CPP架构中,仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We presented a systematic study of occupation-derived skill integration for career path prediction, finding that explicit skill integration provides only marginal and inconsistent gains over strong text-only baselines, even under oracle conditions with ground-truth skills. Our error analysis attributes this to high redundancy between textual and skill-based signals and severe representational collapse in skill embeddings. These findings suggest that practitioners should not assume skill features improve CPP by default, and that future work should explore selective integration strategies targeting cases of textual uncertainty, as well as skill signals extracted directly from individual career narratives rather than inherited from occupation labels.
blocks.zh: 我们对职业技能的整合进行系统研究,以进行职业路径预测,发现明确的技能整合在强有力的文本仅限基线上只能提供边际和不一致的收益,即使在具有地面真实技能的甲骨文条件下也是如此。 我们的错误分析将这一点归因于文字信号和技能信号之间的高度冗余,以及技能嵌入方面的严重代表性崩溃。 这些调查结果表明,从业者不应默认技能特征可以改善CPP,今后的工作应探索针对文字不确定性的选择性融合战略,以及直接从个人职业叙事中提取的技能信号,而不是从职业标签中继承。
